hypothesis_tested: `095` is a governed administrative/status marker: extended after 520/595, clipped terminal after 002-390.

family_rows.parse_implication: `095` can surface as a bare terminal status/result selector when immediately governed by `002-390`.
`520-095` is the dominant non-frame ecology and usually opens a longer tablet/tag trail rather than closing.
`595-095` is a secondary administrative-looking ecology, mostly on Mohenjo-daro tablet rows.
The status-marker bet must be copy-family aware because repeated Mohenjo-daro tablet strings inflate raw `520-095` counts.

decisions.named_bet: `095` is a governed administrative/status marker, not merely a terminal sign
decisions.evidence: Canonical 095 has 22 occurrences; 13/22 follow 390/520/595, 14/22 are on tablet/pot/tag/rod/implement rows, and both 002-390-095 rows are terminal.
decisions.adversary: Raw copy pressure is real: repeated Mohenjo-daro tablet C strings inflate the 520-095 ecology, and the H-1993 half of 002-390-095 is still route-pressure only.
decisions.falsifier_or_rescue: A source-bound 002-390-095 continuation with a name-like tail demotes terminal-status wording; source-preserved 520/595 diversity plus a strict H-1993 terminal side promotes status-marker semantics.

decisions.named_bet: `095` in 002-390-095 is a personal-name/title branch like 125
decisions.evidence: 095 is not concentrated in name-like square/rectangular seal environments: 17/22 canonical occurrences are outside square/rectangular seal rows, and its dominant non-frame ecology is 520/595 before 095.
decisions.adversary: M-71 is a square seal with a 002-390-095 terminal branch, so a title reading is not impossible; the evidence only makes it less natural than status/result.
decisions.falsifier_or_rescue: A cluster of source-visible 002-390-095 seal rows with varied personal-tail continuations would revive a name/title analysis.

decisions.named_bet: `002-390-095` is the clipped terminal version of the longer 520/595-095 status trails
decisions.evidence: The local frame strips 095 to terminal position, while the main non-frame stems 520 and 595 usually continue through 033/585/760/717-style trails.
decisions.adversary: The governing stems are different; 390 may be selecting a homographic branch sign with a different value rather than clipping the same formula class.
decisions.falsifier_or_rescue: A non-frame 390-095 row with an admin/status trail, or a sourced H-1993 terminal side plus comparable Sktd-1 125 continuation, would make this sharper.
